senses.gloss:
Troṭaka
a pupil of Śaṅkarācārya. Oxf. 227b. 257a.
See Toṭaka.

Trotalatantra
one of the 64 tantras ref. to by Lakṣmīdhara in his C. on Saundaryalaharī, Mysore Govt. Ori. Mss. Libr. Ser. 11. p. 84; by Gaurīkānta in his C. on the Saundaryalaharī, Oxf. 109a. Kavīndrācārya 1752.

Trotalottaratantra
one of the 64 tantras ref. to by Lakṣmīdhara in his C. on Saundaryalaharī, Mysore Govt. Ori. Mss. Libr. Ser. 11, p. 84; by Gaurikānta in his C. on Saundaryalaharī, Oxf. 109a. Kavīndrācārya 1753.
